veranderings.voor: Daar het Gail Johnson na hom begin kyk.
veranderings.na: Daar het Gail Johnson na hom begin omsien.
veranderings.rede: 'Omsien na' is the standard written form for caring for someone and echoes the previous sentence, where his mother could not 'na hom omsien'.
'Storie' can suggest something made up; 'nuus' is the natural word for a real event spreading through the country.

veranderings.voor: Daardie reël het gesê 'n openbare skool mag nie
veranderings.na: Volgens daardie reël mag 'n openbare skool nie
veranderings.rede: 'The rule said' is an English pattern; Afrikaans says 'volgens die reël', and the meaning is unchanged.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not a fault, only a note: the protected entry is written 'VIGS' while the lesson and the decided glossary entry write 'vigs' (both AWS forms). The guard ignores case, so nothing needs changing; no change proposed.
